calls.statement:
SELECT tier,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_current,
       COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members,
       SUM(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_ended,
       MIN(valid_from) AS min_from, MAX(valid_from) AS max_from
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members,
       COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS distinct_keys,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS members_with_current,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_current <> (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flag_mismatch,
       MAX(valid_from) AS latest_valid_from,
       COUNT(DISTINCT tier) AS tiers
FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
WITH lastday AS (SELECT MAX(sale_date) AS max_sale FROM fact_sales_line),
gold AS (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold'),
act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key, lastday
  WHERE f.sale_date > lastday.max_sale - 364 AND f.sale_date <= lastday.max_sale
)
SELECT (SELECT max_sale FROM lastday) AS max_sale_date,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold) AS gold_current,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM act)) AS gold_purchased_trailing_364d,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND join_date > DATE '2026-10-07') AS gold_future_join,
       (SELECT MAX(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join_date
